# DPF for zynthian plugins

DPF (DISTRHO Plugin Framework, https://github.com/DISTRHO/DPF) builds the LV2 plugin (DSP), its native GUI (DGL,
Cairo backend → `ui:X11UI` through pugl) and generates the TTL. The project pins DPF as a git submodule (`dpf/`);
when in doubt about an API, read the pinned source and its `examples/` (CairoUI, Meters, Parameters, States,
MidiThrough, SendNote) instead of guessing.

## Project layout (generated by `new_plugin.py`)

```
<symbol>/
  dpf/                         DPF submodule (pinned)
  plugins/<symbol>/
    DistrhoPluginInfo.h        plugin macros: name, URI, I/O, MIDI, UI (Cairo), size, category
    ParamDefs.hpp              parameter + port group table, shared by DSP and GUI
    Plugin.cpp                 DSP (class <Class>Plugin : public Plugin)
    UI.cpp                     native GUI (class <Class>UI : public UI, Cairo)
    Makefile                   NAME, FILES_DSP, FILES_UI, UI_TYPE = cairo, TARGETS = lv2_sep
  zyngui/
    zynthian_widget_<symbol>.py   zynthian widget
    zynthian_widget_<symbol>.html help page
    zyngui.ttl                 zyngui:widget declaration, appended to the bundle's manifest.ttl
    port_extras.json           extra TTL lines per port symbol (zynthian metadata DPF can't express)
  tools/zyngui_bundle.py       post-build step: widget files + manifest + port extras into bin/<symbol>.lv2
  .github/workflows/build.yml  CI: x86_64 + arm64 builds, artifacts, "latest" prerelease, v* releases
  package/                     zynthian package (info.yml, <Package>.sh, Art/): see SKILL.md step 5. Spec keys:
                               package.name (default: the name in Title Case), package.category (Plugins),
                               github (owner/repo; default: gh login/<symbol>)
  spec.json  SPEC.md  README.md  Makefile  LICENSE (GPL v3 text, for the default license)
```

Top `make`: `dgl` (DGL Cairo lib) → `plugins` → `gen` (`dpf/utils/generate-ttl.sh`: runs the built plugin to write
`manifest.ttl`, `<symbol>_dsp.ttl`, `<symbol>_ui.ttl`) → `zyngui`. Output: `bin/<symbol>.lv2/`. `gen` runs the
plugin binary, so build natively on the target (the zynthian, aarch64): no cross-compiling.

## Parameters → LV2 ports → zynthian

`ParamDefs.hpp` holds one entry per parameter; `Plugin::initParameter()` copies it into DPF's `Parameter`:

| ParamDef / DPF `Parameter` | LV2 TTL | zynthian |
|---|---|---|
| `symbol` | `lv2:symbol` | controller symbol, monitor key, preset/snapshot key (**stable API**) |
| `name` | `lv2:name` | controller label |
| `min/max/def` (`ranges`) | `lv2:minimum/maximum/default` | range |
| `unit` (`"dB"`, `"Hz"`, `"ms"`, `"s"`, `"%"`) | `unit:unit` / `unit:render` | shown with the value |
| hint `kParameterIsAutomatable` | (default) | |
| hint `kParameterIsInteger` | `lv2:integer` | integer controller |
| hint `kParameterIsBoolean` | `lv2:toggled` | toggle |
| hint `kParameterIsTrigger` | `pprop:trigger` | trigger (momentary) |
| hint `kParameterIsLogarithmic` | `pprop:logarithmic` | log knob |
| hint `kParameterIsHidden` | `pprop:notOnGUI` | not shown as controller |
| hint `kParameterIsOutput` | `lv2:OutputPort` | **monitor** for the widget (not a controller) |
| `enumValues` (restricted) | `lv2:enumeration` + `lv2:scalePoint` | selector with labels |
| `groupId` → `initPortGroup()` | `pg:group` with `lv2:name`/`lv2:symbol` | **control page** title (4 controls per page) |
| `designation` `kParameterDesignationBypass` (spec `"designation": "bypass"`) | port `lv2_enabled` ("Enabled", `lv2:toggled`, default 1, `lv2:designation lv2:enabled`): DPF inverts it, the plugin sees 1 = bypassed. No `pg:group` from DPF: the generator adds it via port_extras | the processor's native **bypass** (`is_bypass`, `bypass_value` 0, labels inline/bypass), last control of its page. Without it, zynthian adds a JACK-routing "bypass" to audio effects |

DPF can't express some zynthian metadata. The generator adds it to `zyngui/port_extras.json` from these spec keys:

| spec key | TTL added | zynthian |
|---|---|---|
| params[].`designation`: `attack`, `decay`, `sustain`, `release`, `delay`, `hold`, `fade`, `cutoffFrequency` (or `cutoff`), `resonance`, `drawbar` | `lv2:designation <http://lv2plug.in/ns/ext/parameters#...>` | the page containing it shows zynthian's built-in **envelope** / **filter** / **drawbar** widget (instead of the plugin's widget) |
| params[].`designation`: `bypass` (added automatically to audio effects that lack it) | (DPF designation, see above) + the port's `pg:group` | native bypass |
| groups[].`class`: `envelope`, `filter`, `oscillator`, `control` | `a param:EnvelopeControls` / `FilterControls` / `OscillatorControls` / `ControlGroup` on the group | semantic only (other hosts, documentation) |
| widget.`half_height`: true | (widget code) `self.rows = self.rows // 2` | see zynthian-widget.md |

Anything else (control order inside a page with `lv2:displayPriority`, group order, ...) goes directly into
`zyngui/port_extras.json`:

```json
{ "gain": ["lv2:displayPriority 100"], "attack": ["lv2:designation <http://lv2plug.in/ns/ext/parameters#attack>"] }
```

`tools/zyngui_bundle.py` inserts each line (with ` ;`) after the port's `lv2:symbol "<symbol>" ;` in
`<symbol>_dsp.ttl` on every build (`"group:<symbol>"` keys go into the group's block). Higher `displayPriority` =
shown first. Use full IRIs (`<http://...>`): DPF's TTL doesn't declare the `param:` prefix.

**Examples to learn from**: `~/Zynthian/zynthian-data/lv2-custom/*/` holds curated TTLs for ~50 plugins (copied over
the installed bundles by zynthian-sys `update_zynthian_data.sh`): port groups (mostly of 4), ADSR and filter
designations, group classes, display priorities, scale points. Nekobi is a DPF plugin (DPF-generated TTL, curated);
`mod-mda-JX10.lv2/JX10.ttl` uses group classes and designations; `Obxd.lv2/Obxd.ttl` a large synth in pages of 4.

## LV2 category → zynthian engine list

`DISTRHO_PLUGIN_LV2_CATEGORY` (spec `lv2_category`) decides where the plugin appears in zynthian's engine list
(`lv2class2engcat` in `zyngine/zynthian_lv2.py`); the type (MIDI Synth, Audio Effect, ...) also depends on the ports.

| `lv2:...Plugin` | zynthian category |
|---|---|
| Instrument | Synth |
| Delay | Delay |
| Reverb | Reverb |
| Compressor, Dynamics, Expander, Gate, Limiter | Dynamics |
| Filter, EQ, Highpass, Lowpass, Spectral | Filter & EQ |
| Distortion | Distortion |
| Chorus, Flanger, Phaser, Modulator, Envelope | Modulation |
| Amplifier, Simulator | Simulator |
| Analyser | Analyzer |
| Spatial / Pitch (`lv2:PitchPlugin` is "Pitch Shifter") | Spatial / Pitch |
| Oscillator, Generator | Oscillator, Generator (Audio Generator) |
| Utility (and anything else) | Other |

## DSP essentials (`Plugin.cpp`)

- `run(const float** inputs, float** outputs, uint32_t frames)` (+ `const MidiEvent* midiEvents, uint32_t
  midiEventCount` when MIDI input is enabled). Inputs/outputs may alias: read all inputs of a frame before writing.
- Parameter values: `setParameterValue()` stores inputs; `getParameterValue()` returns inputs and **outputs** (the
  host reads outputs after each `run()`): compute output values in `run()` into members.
- Output values for meters: hold peaks with a time-based decay so ~30 Hz polling doesn't miss them.
- `activate()`, `deactivate()`, `sampleRateChanged()`, `getSampleRate()`: precompute coefficients there.
- RT-safe: no `new`/`malloc`, locks, I/O or logging in `run()`. Smooth parameters that click (one-pole).
- Bypass (audio effects): the template crossfades the processed signal to the dry input with `fBypassMix`
  (0 → 1 in 10 ms, `isBypassed()` reads `fValues[kBypassParam]`). Keep it when writing the DSP: compute `wet`,
  output `wet + (dry - wet) * fBypassMix`. Fully bypassed, the DSP may be skipped; reset its state (delay lines,
  filters) when processing resumes, so no stale audio comes out.
- DPF: a git submodule pinned to a tested commit (`DPF_COMMIT` in `new_plugin.py`); never copy its sources into
  the plugin repo. Move the pin only on purpose, after building and testing with the new commit.
- State (non-float data, e.g. file paths): `DISTRHO_PLUGIN_WANT_STATE` + `initState()`/`setState()`/`getState()`.
  zynthian supports LV2 path parameters too: ask before going this way.
- MIDI out: `DISTRHO_PLUGIN_WANT_MIDI_OUTPUT` + `writeMidiEvent()`. Synth: `DISTRHO_PLUGIN_IS_SYNTH 1`.
- Latency: `DISTRHO_PLUGIN_WANT_LATENCY` + `setLatency()`.

## Native GUI (`UI.cpp`, Cairo)

- `DISTRHO_UI_USE_CAIRO 1`: the UI is a `CairoTopLevelWidget`; draw in `onCairoDisplay(const
  CairoGraphicsContext& ctx)` with `cairo_t* cr = ctx.handle`.
- Host → UI: `parameterChanged(index, value)` (inputs and outputs): store, then `repaint()`.
- UI → host: `editParameter(index, true)`, `setParameterValue(index, value)` (while dragging),
  `editParameter(index, false)`.
- Input: `onMouse(const MouseEvent&)` (`ev.button`, `ev.press`, `ev.pos`), `onMotion(const MotionEvent&)`,
  `onScroll(const ScrollEvent&)` (`ev.delta.getY()`). Return true when handled.
- Size: `DISTRHO_UI_DEFAULT_WIDTH/HEIGHT`; lay out from `getWidth()`/`getHeight()` (resizable).
- Widgets: DGL has `CairoImageKnob`, `CairoImageSwitch` (PNG skins, see examples/CairoUI); vector drawing is
  usually simpler to maintain.
- On zynthian it's shown by `jalv.gtk3` on the VNC display (`:1`) when VNC is enabled. Test there (testing.md).

## Building

- On the zynthian: `zyn_device.sh build <dir>` (rsync + `make -j4`). Needs: build-essential, pkg-config,
  libcairo2-dev, libx11-dev, libxext-dev, libxrandr-dev, libxcursor-dev, libgl-dev (present on zynthian OS).
- Locally (x86, for compile checks or desktop tests): same packages, `make`; plus `jalv` (with gtk3) to run it.
  The bundle built locally is x86: never copy it to the zynthian.
- `make clean` cleans DPF too (full rebuild of DGL next time: ~1-2 min on a Pi 5).
- GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/build.yml`): on every push and pull request, x86_64 (`ubuntu-24.04`) and
  arm64 (`ubuntu-24.04-arm`, native: `make gen` runs the plugin) builds inside `debian:<ci.debian>` (spec key,
  default `trixie` = zynthian OS base), with the DPF submodule at its pinned commit. Artifacts
  `<symbol>-lv2-<arch>.tar.gz`; pushes to the default branch replace the `latest` prerelease, `vX.Y.Z` tags create a
  release (the CI fails if the tag doesn't match `getVersion()`; the zynthian package installs the release set with
  `tools/package_pr.py`, or the `latest` build while there is none). arm64 runners are free for public repos only: for a private repo, drop that matrix entry or use a
  paid/self-hosted runner. When the zynthian OS moves to a new Debian release, update `container:` (and `ci.debian`).
- The CI arm64 bundle runs on the zynthian (generic aarch64 flags, same Debian): an alternative to building on the
  device, e.g. for users installing a released version.
